title: Interface sweep A (English and Dutch): leads, contacts, dashboard, calendar, tasks, follow-ups
goal: Every user-visible string on these pages comes from the catalogue with complete English and Dutch, and i18n-check enforces it.
why: R210 converted only the shell and shared components; about 920 hard-coded strings remain in these folders (scanFile count 2026-10-21). Owner decision: Dutch interface in scope, at least every screen the client film shows. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17.

edit: every .tsx/.ts file under the scope folders (strings only)

items.what: Convert every finding of node desktop/scripts/i18n-check.mjs for the scope folders to t() (JSX text, text props, toasts, setError, data labels, column headers, empty states, confirm dialogs, aria-labels). Keys go in the namespace of the page (leads.*, contacts.*, ...); reuse common.* and status.* keys where the meaning is identical. Values and interpolations keep the current English exactly, so English screens do not change.

Machine-translate every new key into nl (complete; placeholders identical); hi and ar may stay partial. List the namespace files in docs/i18n/nl-review/R156.md as 'machine translated, needs native review'.
Add desktop/scripts/i18n-scope/crm-overview.json listing the scope folders, so i18n-check enforces them from now on.

e2e/i18n-nl-crm-overview.spec.ts: switch to Nederlands, open every page in scope (list, detail, new/edit forms, drawers), assert no missing-key console warnings, html lang nl, and run the layout probe (desktop/scripts/layout-probe.mjs helpers or the rtl.spec.ts pattern) for overflow caused by longer Dutch text; fix overflow with layout (wrap, min-w-0, truncate with title), never by shortening the translation to English.

tests: i18n-check passes with the new scope file and zero findings in the scope folders.
Existing e2e for the area (leads, leads-board, contacts, dashboard, calendar, tasks, follow-ups) pass unchanged in English.
acceptance: No hard-coded English remains in the scope folders; Dutch is complete for them; English screens are pixel-identical in text.
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/i18n-nl-crm-overview.spec.ts e2e/leads.spec.ts e2e/leads-board.spec.ts e2e/contacts.spec.ts e2e/dashboard.spec.ts e2e/calendar.spec.ts e2e/tasks.spec.ts e2e/follow-ups.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
No behaviour change: strings only (plus layout fixes for longer Dutch text).
Keys only in this batch's namespace files; never edit messages/index.ts (the files exist since R136).
RTL-safe classes in any layout fix (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-).
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test; e2e selectors that use English text keep working because tests run in English.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17, desktop/scripts/i18n-check.mjs (what counts as a finding), the R210 batch file for the conventions already used (key naming, i18n-ignore for example values).
R157 runs in parallel on other folders and namespaces.
goLiveVerify: Native review of the Dutch files listed in docs/i18n/NL-REVIEW.md.
